card.name: Words that introduce a condition or timing
card.fires_on: Small condition or timing words such as "as", "when" and "late" that follow a verb and set up a circumstance. Also seen inside the word "delirious".

modes.label: Condition linking words
modes.description: "as" or "when" after a verb, introducing the circumstance in which something happens.
modes.example: Beta-1 selectivity diminishes<< as>> dosage is increased.

modes.label: Late stage marker
modes.description: The word "late" in parentheses after a symptom, marking the stage of onset.

modes.label: Inside delirious
modes.description: The middle of the word "delirious" in a story.

card.plain: It fires on little words like "as" or "when" that say under what condition or at what time something happens.
